value: per-site H5 slope contrast (pjmA minus scmR, site-median |rho-1| slope over K) at 14-18 minus at 16-20; exact two-sided signed-rank, HL estimate with exact interval; stronger at 14-18 = site difference < 0

event days of a site sorted by date; a new heat episode starts when the gap to the previous event day exceeds 3 calendar days (so days at most 3 days apart share an episode). event_days = distinct R1 days with at least one scored building-event (results/run/events_R1.pkl); event_days_designated = the 10 R1 days of results/frozen/event_dates.csv (primary flag), of which Lamb has only 4 with scored buildings

one-sided 95 % Clopper-Pearson lower bound for the share of exchangeable sites showing the stated direction (H1, H2: delta/log-ratio below 0; H4: site p-cross below 0.10; H5: slope contrast below 0 = SCM-ridge error grows faster); BDG2 sites are not a random sample, so the bound is conditional on exchangeability
value = coverage (n-1)/(n+1) = 10/12 of [min, max] of the 11 site values for one new exchangeable site; ci_low = min, ci_high = max

tip_threshold = largest site p-cross: for any pre-set threshold above it all 11 sites are below and the sign test is unchanged (2^-11). tip_k_min_holm = fewest sites below the threshold for which the H4 sign-test p still passes Holm with the other four frozen p-values; tip_threshold_holm = that k-th smallest site p-cross: the Holm decision for H4 is unchanged for any threshold above it

PREREG s6: 'Secondary rule family (NYISO, CAISO, ISO-NE) for H1 and H2 endpoints, Holm within that family'. p_holm_family = Holm over the three rules of one endpoint (m = 3); p_holm_family6 = sensitivity reading, one family of six (3 rules x H1s, H2s, m = 6). Inputs: exact one-sided signed-rank p of the ledger rows H1s.delta_bias.<rule> and H2s.logratio.<rule>; the value column is the adjusted p, p_raw the raw p; no confirmatory p_holm is touched

p-cross x shaped-hours load (hours s-4..s-1, kWh, as X5) / (c x window load, hours s..e-1 = 14-18, kWh) with c = 0.10: the share of the shed energy that a pre-event load increase of the break-even size adds back. Site load = median over buildings of the median over events (X5 construction, window load = frozen R1 column L); pooled = building-pooled medians with the pooled p-cross; sites with p-cross 0 (Eagle, Lamb) give 0

PJM-adj payment divided by the true shed energy for a participant that curtails c = 0.10 of the window load and raises the 4 h before the event by the break-even p: payment energy = B - (1 - c) L, true shed = c L, so the multiplier is 1 + bias / c with bias = median over buildings of the building mean of (B - L) / L at p (frozen analysis.precool_tables, H4 pair support, pooled p-cross for the pooled value, each site's own p-cross for the site values; reproduces precool.bias.pjmA.4h.p0 and p0.1). phantom_payment_share = (bias(p) - bias(0)) / c = the extra payment from the increase alone, as a share of the true shed. Linear in B; assumes the curtailment does not move the adjustment hours and a payment proportional to B - L_obs

edge = relMAE_median(PJM-adj) - relMAE_median(rule) at p = 0.05, c = 0.10 (ledger contam.q<q>.<m>.relMAE_median; key tag 'q0' = q 0, 'q0.25' = 0.25, 'q0.5' = 0.5, 'q1' = 1); positive = the rule is more accurate than PJM-adj. q_cross = linear interpolation of the first q at which SCM-ridge's edge turns non-positive, on the four-point grid (descriptive)
